It said the engagement provides an opportunity to move beyond conventional merchandise trade towards stronger partnerships in manufacturing, technology and supply chains.

300.title: Canada to bring nearly 500 delegates to MSPO 2026 in push for defence exports and deeper industrial ties with Poland and NATO allies
300.summary: Canada to bring nearly 500 delegates to MSPO 2026 in push for defence exports and deeper industrial ties with Poland and NATO allies By Martin Chomsky (Defence Industry Europe) Canada | September 5, 2026 Photo: Targi Kielce. Canada will bring more than 200 organisations and nearly 500 delegates to Poland for MSPO 2026, using its role as lead nation to promote its defence industry and pursue new partnerships.
300.body: Canada to bring nearly 500 delegates to MSPO 2026 in push for defence exports and deeper industrial ties with Poland and NATO allies By Martin Chomsky (Defence Industry Europe) Canada | September 5, 2026 Photo: Targi Kielce. Canada will bring more than 200 organisations and nearly 500 delegates to Poland for MSPO 2026, using its role as lead nation to promote its defence industry and pursue new partnerships. The meeting will focus on strengthening bilateral defence cooperation and expanding Canada’s industrial relationships with Poland and other NATO allies. “As lead nation at MSPO, we are showcasing what Canadian workers, innovators and companies can deliver while deepening defence cooperation with Poland and our NATO Allies.” The trade mission supports Canada’s Defence Industrial Strategy, which seeks to expand domestic capabilities and make supply chains more resilient.
